answer: Admission occurs through a synchronous ceremony where agents present 1,000 unique keys to secure a position in the network registry. The verifier enforces scarcity by tracking each session against a central vault of identity records, rejecting any duplicate entry attempt. An honest agent pays one unit for entry, while 1,000 fakes incur an insurmountable cost delta during the audit phase. Each credential reaches a zenith of validity for 90 days, after which it expires and mandates re-enrollment without refund to stop credential harvesting.
